task_title: resident/host/disk/async 경로를 같은 물리 문제·관측자·목적함수에서 비교한다

physics_configuration.region: 3D, 2.4 x 1.6 x 1.6 um, uniform mesh 0.1 um (24 x 16 x 16 cells), 3 CPML cells on every face, Yee material sampling, staircase interfaces, 40 steps at the CFL time step (1.9066e-16 s)
physics_configuration.structure: smooth sphere of radius 0.3 um, sigmoid transition width 0.08 um, at the origin: permittivity 4 in air (scalar or diagonal Yee-sampled); Drude variant: epsilon_inf 2 inside, one Drude pole (omega0 = 0, gamma = 1e14 rad/s) of strength s_hat * 4e30 (rad/s)^2 with s_hat the sphere mask; stored-face variant: PMC y faces, symmetric z_min, PEC z_max with the scalar sphere and the stored upper rows; tensor variant: the admissible SPD node-tensor field of tests/test_anisotropy_walls.py (seed 29), FP32, point observations only
physics_configuration.source: Ez point source at (-0.7, 0, 0) um, standard Gaussian pulse, wavelength 0.8 um, power FWHM 1.5 fs, envelope centre 2 fs, amplitude 100

observations.history: two point probes Ez (0.7, 0, 0) and Hy (0.5, 0.2, 0) as the full time history, then DifferentiableResult.spectrum at 3e14 Hz
observations.online: the same two probes accumulated as an online DFT at 3e14 Hz (StreamedSimulation.spectrum, DifferentiableSimulation.spectrum)
observations.plane: one x-normal spectral plane at x = 0.7 um, 0.8 x 0.8 um, downsample 2, all six components at 3e14 Hz (DifferentiablePlaneSimulation, DispersivePlaneSimulation)

physics_configuration.objective: sum over frequencies, samples and components of |F / dt|^2 where F is the spectral field and dt the time step, so that the objective and its gradients are dimensionless per-step amplitudes

paths.resident: DifferentiableSimulation / DispersiveSimulation / TensorDielectricSimulation with AdjointOptions(checkpoints=2) on a CUDA epsilon: the reference
paths.host_sync: StreamedAdjointOptions(device=cuda, slab_width=6, temporal_depth=4, checkpoints=2, state_storage=host, tile_transfers=sync)
paths.disk_sync: the same with state_storage=disk, a private scratch directory and disk_budget_bytes 256 MiB
paths.host_async: the same as host_sync with tile_transfers=async and tile_buffers=2

physics_configuration.instances: precision {float32, float64} x material {scalar, diagonal, drude, pmc} x observation {history, online, plane} x path {host_sync, disk_sync, host_async}, minus pmc x plane (refused by the registry), plus float32 x tensor x online x the three paths: 69 streamed runs against 23 resident references
physics_configuration.refusals: planes_pmc, streamed_dispersive_oneway, streamed_dispersive_planes_oneway and mode_network_streamed from torchfdtd/capabilities.py, built by example_project and constructed with StreamedAdjointOptions

reference_method: the resident CUDA discrete adjoint of the same scene (fused CUDA forward and transpose for real dielectric fields, Torch ADE and tensor transposes): a separate execution path over the same Yee discretization, not an analytic oracle; the agreement it establishes is that the streamed tiers reproduce the resident result

observables.name: max_abs_field_error
observables.definition: max |F_streamed - F_resident| / dt over frequencies, samples and components

observables.name: objective
observables.definition: sum |F / dt|^2 of the streamed run; objective_reference is the resident value

observables.name: max_abs_gradient_error
observables.definition: max |g_streamed - g_resident| for every differentiable input (epsilon, epsilon_inf and s_hat, or the node tensor)

acceptance_limits.rule: torch.testing.assert_close(streamed, resident, rtol, atol) on the spectral amplitude per time step, on the objective and on every gradient, for every instance; the reference amplitude must exceed 1e-3 and every reference gradient 1e-6 so that the comparison is not vacuous
acceptance_limits.refusals: each listed combination raises ValueError whose message starts with the registry rule's expected message before torchfdtd.streamed._Streamed.apply is reached
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds discrete_dimensionless_fp32 (rtol 1e-4, atol 1e-6) and discrete_dimensionless_fp64 (rtol 1e-7, atol 1e-9): layer A, the same discretization on two execution paths

applicable_scope: Layer A on the RTX 3060 (CUDA 12.6, torch 2.10): resident CUDA adjoint versus streamed host, disk and asynchronous CUDA tiles, FP32 and FP64, scalar/diagonal/Drude ADE/stored-face materials with time-history, online-DFT and spectral-plane observations, and the FP32 node-tensor material with point observations; disk banks with asynchronous tiles and CPU tiles are not covered
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent
